evidence.normative: For R2007+, CadValue flag 0x01 selects kGeneral/type 512; the common data-type BL is omitted and the payload is a BL byte count followed by that many bytes.
evidence.localReproduction: Before the fix, generated AC1021 and AC1024 FIELD root/child values could not retain the expected type-512 raw payload because the parser treated flag 0x01 as an empty value while consuming a data-type BL.

change: FIELD CadValue parsing now infers type 512 and omits the data-type BL when flag 0x01 is set. FIELD DWG writing mirrors the layout, rejects a kGeneral flag paired with any non-512 type, and validates a supplied data size against retained raw bytes. Empty-value handling is limited to flag 0x02, consistent with the existing TABLE route. Unflagged explicit type 512 remains supported.

ac1021: root kGeneral payload and detached format/value strings
child kGeneral payload and detached key/format/value strings
explicit type 512 when flag 0x01 is clear
ac1024: root kGeneral payload and detached format/value strings
child kGeneral payload and detached key/format/value strings
explicit type 512 when flag 0x01 is clear
generatedControls.writerRefusal: A FIELD value with flag 0x01 paired with type 1 is rejected.
